data.name: Outliar
data.detailed_description:
The hyperjump is locked in. The destination is set. All you have to do is keep the ship running, but someone on board

has other plans.

Outliar is a multiplayer first-person social deduction game where a crew of spacefarers must work together to

maintain their starship and reach their destination, while an impostor hidden among them works to bring it all

crashing down.

At the start of each match, one player is secretly assigned the role of Impostor. The rest are Crewmates. For the

first 30 seconds, nobody knows who's who. Then the roles are revealed, but only to each individual player. Trust no

one.

Crewmates: Keep the Ship Alive

As a crewmate, your job is to complete tasks scattered across the ship's Upper and Lower Decks. Reroute power in

Electrical. Calibrate the reactor. Balance oxygen in Life Support. Stabilize uplinks in the Nexus. Every task you

finish brings the ship closer to its destination and strengthens the hull's integrity.

But watch your back. The impostor is out there, armed and dangerous.

Impostor: Tear It All Apart

As the impostor, your goal is simple: eliminate the crew before they reach the destination. Use your taser to take

down unsuspecting crewmates. Swing a baton in close quarters. Sabotage integrity tasks to weaken the ship from the

inside. Play it cool, blend in, and strike when the moment is right.

Key Features

- First-Person Social Deduction - Experience the tension of hidden-role gameplay from a first-person perspective,

where every corridor could hide a threat.

- 13 Unique Tasks - From wiring puzzles and memory games to reactor calibration and data downloads, each task is a

hands-on minigame that keeps crewmates engaged and vulnerable.

- Two-Deck Starship - Navigate between the Upper and Lower Decks via the elevator system. Use the ship's layout to

your advantage, whether you're hunting or hiding.

- Proximity Voice Chat - Communicate with nearby players in real time. Coordinate with your crew, or use your voice to

deceive.

- Steam P2P Multiplayer - Quick and easy matchmaking through Steam lobbies. No dedicated servers needed.

- Combat and Weapons - Tasers, batons, and health packs are scattered throughout the ship. Crewmates can fight back if

they find the impostor in time.

- Ship Integrity and Destination Progress - Two competing meters drive the match. Crewmates push destination progress

forward by completing tasks. The impostor drags ship integrity down through sabotage. When one hits its limit, the

game is over.

How to Win

- Crewmates win by reaching the destination or eliminating the impostor.

- The Impostor wins by defeating all crewmates or destroying the ship's integrity.

Every match is a race against time, trust, and each other.

data.short_description: Outliar is a 3D multiplayer social deduction game. Complete tasks, maintain ship systems, and use proximity voice chat to find the impostor hiding among your crew.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Corei3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with OpenGL 3.3 / Vulkan support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 and Apple Silicon (M1+)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: x86_64, Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan-compatible GPU
